slots.name: execution time
slots.sentence: Hegseth said deciding to execute Hasan by firing squad at Fort Hood on a Thursday at 1 pm - the approximate time, day of the week and location of Hasan's shooting - was a "no brainer."

slots.name: people killed
slots.sentence: Hegseth said earlier this week that the public will be able to watch a livestream the firing squad execution of former Army Maj. Nidal Malik Hasan, who was convicted in 2009 of killing 13 people and injuring 31 others in a shooting at the Fort Hood military base in Texas.
